02 / MY STORY

I follow the
useful question.

My foundation is in human resources and people programs. Curiosity led me to learn code, build with AI, and test myself in global machine learning challenges.

I believe in outcomes over actions. A course mattered because it helped me create something; a model mattered because it held up on a leaderboard; a website mattered because someone could use it. I want this space to show both the work and what came of it.

See my professional journey ↗

03 / THE LEARNING PATH

I learned it
by building it.

None of these projects appeared fully formed. I learned a skill, tried it on a real problem, and kept going. Here is the path that helped me get there.

  1. 01

    Computer science foundations

    Learned the basics of programming through Harvard's CS50 course.

  2. 02

    Python, one lesson at a time

    Learned Python through YouTube and bootcamps, then put it to work.

  3. 03

    Machine learning in practice

    Built and refined models through Kaggle competitions, where results are measurable.

  4. 04

    From idea to website

    Learned to make websites with AI tools, including Vercel's v0, and used that skill to ship products.
